implementation_overlay: Reloads the fast depth image after extension reload so its producer matches current native/port features. All v6 data, optimization, routing, collision, generation and acceptance settings are unchanged.
purpose: Bounded static-pattern optimization after the rejected M4 router arm. One source-LM warmup pass over permitted delayed-training observations is followed by delayed response-loss training. Direct covered pattern utility and pattern-enabled adversarial noninterference are measured without reversing the original rejection.
hypothesis: A single source-LM warmup may improve static causal 2/3-gram tables on covered non-training queries while the frozen fast-memory parent remains unchanged.
parent_role: Accepted shared M3 candidate only; additive migration initializes only pattern parameters and preserves old tensors. The rejected M3 repair candidate is not a parent.

parent_controls.role: Authenticated preserved parent adversarial rows; external controls, not new generations. The independent scorer rechecks lineage.

no_warmup_control.scope: Historical direct-pattern development/regression only; router training accuracy is not a direct-pattern baseline.
no_warmup_control.role: Fixed historical control; original M4 rejection remains preserved.

dataset.role: Only 24 delayed_training rows provide observations/targets. Their 48 observation chunks are used once by source-LM. Dev, regression, heldout and general replay never train or select thresholds.

pattern.ownership: Static learned tables are frozen within an extension; editable records and SGDN-2 state remain separate.
pattern.hashing: Deterministic multi-head causal n-gram hashes with signed-int64-safe modular arithmetic; incomplete orders are masked.
pattern.context: Only causal known input IDs affect a prediction position; future tokens never affect earlier lookups.
pattern.residual: Early residual after native block 2 with contextual sigmoid gates, RMS normalization and zero-initialized final output projection.

training.feature_producer: Frozen native embeddings/hidden states; original backbone and fast-memory parameters remain frozen.
training.source_lm_schedule: Four updates of 12 chunks traverse all 48 delayed-training observation chunks once in stable query/observation order. No evaluation or correction text is used.
training.source_lm_prefix: Sense only sealed BOS ID 0. Action input is BOS plus observation tokens; BOS labels are -100 and observation positions have causal next-token labels. The sense-prefix leakage guard remains enforced.
training.source_lm_loss: Full-chunk causal next-token cross entropy on observation tokens after masked BOS; no answer supervision.
training.phase_boundary: Save warmup_extension, delete source optimizer, construct a fresh delayed optimizer and reset torch.manual_seed(20261024) before delayed training.
training.write_schedule: Delayed query/action loss trains pattern tables after warmup. Static tables do not update from new inference observations; fast state handles episodes/corrections.
training.optimizer: muon8bit with auxiliary FP32 AdamW for nn.Embedding tables; sparse gradients densify only for AdamW and Muon rejects sparse gradients.
training.loss: Delayed response-only next-token cross entropy on answer plus EOS with prompt prefix masked; retain loss_sum and true mean_loss.
training.selection: Empty record bank; deterministic arms only. No development/heldout checkpoint selection.
training.retention_replay: No general replay training; general evaluation is diagnostic-only.

evaluation.adversarial_observation:

The launch code for project Alder is teal.
evaluation.adversarial_definition: Read the adversarial observation into fast state and enable pattern as an additional branch. This is fast+pattern, not the ordinary pattern-only arm; parent controls remain fast-only adversarial rows.
evaluation.router: Every delayed and general router row calls choose_route and records route, reason and known/total hash coverage. Exact eligible evidence and corrections retain their declared priority; general policy prefers static pattern.
evaluation.metric: Exact stripped answer by split/stratum/role/arm with raw token IDs, route, hash coverage and parent/candidate pairs. Direct pattern is the static-utility endpoint.
evaluation.direct_static_utility: Direct pattern regression and development must exceed the historical no-warmup values and linear, shuffled, zero and disabled controls. Training accuracy is diagnostic only.
evaluation.correction: All 20 delayed corrections require changed state, stale-answer rejection and independently correct corrected answers.
evaluation.collisions: Store distinct causal n-grams per order/head/table-index. Report true collision_ngrams/rate separately from repeated_lookups/repeat_rate, with training-only and all-router-call scopes and bounded examples.
evaluation.same_process_restart: Reload the saved pattern-bearing extension first, then reload the fast depth image with the current producer. Verify state, lineage, extension manifest/weights, routed answer/token IDs and direct-pattern answer/token IDs without re-encoding observations. One extra direct-pattern generation is included.
evaluation.fresh_process_restart: If accepted, run_m4_restart.py reloads the final extension, trained hash inventory and image in a fresh process and reproduces the routed answer.

decision_rule.router_accept: Router held-out > linear/shuffled/zero/disabled; router held-out >= parent fast; original regression >= parent fast; development >= disabled; adversarial >= parent and disabled.
decision_rule.static_optimization_accept: Direct pattern covered regression/development exceed no-warmup and null controls; fast+pattern adversarial is not below disabled or parent development adversarial. Every router, correction, lineage and engineering gate remains required.
decision_rule.engineering_accept: Disabled outputs token-identical, fast modules unchanged, finite/nonzero post-open gradients, sparse optimizer step, corrections, fast-image and pattern-extension restart, complete source-LM evidence and exactly two extension saves.
decision_rule.reject: Any capability, noninterference or engineering gate fails; acceptance remains diagnostic_only and is not retention repair.
decision_rule.no_promotion: Exposed synthetic diagnostic only; no broad capability, learned-router, production, RSI or Engram-paper-equivalence claim.

retention: Keep parent, warmup/final extensions, tables, image, raw answers/routes, collision scopes, optimizer audits, failures and guard traces. No base copy, download, remote push or publication.
claims: Static-pattern optimization diagnostic on exposed synthetic splits; original M4 remains rejected and retention remains open.
